aarti.tek: Om, victory to Ekādaśī, victory to Ekādaśī, victory to Mother Ekādaśī. Whoever keeps the vow of Viṣṇu's worship gains strength and liberation.
aarti.pad1: Let me recount your names, Goddess, giver of devotion. Mother, you give glory to the multitude, and the scriptures describe you. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Utpannā is the Ekādaśī of the dark fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, born as the saviour of the world. In the bright fortnight she became Mokṣadā, and came as the giver of liberation. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: That of the dark fortnight of Pauṣa is named Saphalā; in the bright fortnight comes Putradā, and great joy abides. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: In the month of Māgha, the one that comes in the dark fortnight is named Ṣaṭtilā; in the bright fortnight she is called Jayā, and victory is ever won. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: In the dark fortnight of Phālguna is Vijayā, in the bright fortnight Āmalakī. In the dark fortnight is Pāpamocanī, the mighty one of Caitra. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: In the bright fortnight of Caitra her name is Kāmadā, the giver of wealth. The one of the dark fortnight of the month of Vaiśākha is named Varūthinī. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: In the bright fortnight comes Mohinī; Aparā is of the dark fortnight of Jyeṣṭha. Nirjalā is the name of the giver of every happiness, kept in the bright fortnight. ॥7॥
aarti.pad8: Know Yoginī as the name in Āṣāḍha, kept in the dark fortnight; the one that falls in the bright fortnight is called Devaśayanī. ॥8॥
aarti.pad9: Kāmikā comes in the month of Śrāvaṇa: call her the one of the dark fortnight. In the bright fortnight of Śrāvaṇa is Pavitrā; live in joy. ॥9॥
aarti.pad10: Ajā is of the dark fortnight of Bhādrapada, Parivartinī of the bright. In the dark fortnight of Āśvina is Indirā; by her fast one has come out of the ocean of worldly existence. ॥10॥
aarti.pad11: Pāpāṅkuśā is in the bright fortnight; she herself takes away sin. Ramā comes in the month of Kārttika, a great giver of happiness. ॥11॥
aarti.pad12: Devotthānī is of the bright fortnight, the Mother who destroys sorrow. In this holy month I make my plea: carry my boat across. ॥12॥
aarti.pad13: Paramā falls in the dark fortnight and brings good to the people. In the bright half of the month comes Padminī, who takes away sorrow and poverty. ॥13॥
aarti.pad14: Whoever sings the āratī of Ekādaśī with devotion, says her servant Gurditta, surely gains a dwelling in heaven. ॥14॥
